import { defineTable, col } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - the foreign key way_nodes_id_fkey spans (way_id, version); a relation holds one column, so its columns are plain columns.
export const wayNodes = defineTable("way_nodes", {
    columns: {
        wayId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        nodeId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        version: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        sequenceId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey()
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
